text:
Type: white tabletop picture frame
Use: displaying a photo or small print on a desk, shelf or sideboard, also on a wall; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: matte white painted frame, white mat, clear front panel, black fold-out back stand
Colors: white, cream mat, black stand
Shape: portrait rectangle with a deep box profile, thin mat around the opening, stands upright on a back leg, compact
Feel: clean, simple, personal, fresh
Goes with: family photos, art cards, white shelves, light wood desks; Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

product.name: RIBBA
product.description: Can be used hanging or standing, both horizontally and vertically, to fit in the space available.
